findings.evidence: The repair-cycle audit identified that a new cash_margin_collateral_transfer_pair row model was not yet bound by every artifact, so a formal run could have a governed dictionary table that the protocol did not require.
findings.fix_required: Make the bound-table inventory exactly equal across DAC, RP and DD; require replay_run_id plus replay_run_freeze_record_sha256 on every run-dependent table; add a machine check for equality and duplicates.
verification_evidence: independent quant-risk static audit: 26/26 bound tables and 38-field parent crosswalk

findings.evidence: Cash, debit, margin and collateral postings did not previously force an immutable two-leg transfer representation with a zero net-NAV effect and a dated source for collateral movement.
findings.fix_required: Require one negative CASH transfer leg and one positive MARGIN or COLLATERAL leg for each initial-margin, maintenance-margin or collateral transfer; restrict DEBIT to nonnegative debit accrual; route every posted effect into exactly one balance bucket.
verification_evidence: independent quant-risk static audit: paired cash/margin/collateral zero-NAV checks passed

findings.evidence: A futures design that allows contract notional or an unrealized marked position to enter NAV alongside variation margin can create an artificial profit or loss path.
findings.fix_required: Use FUTURES_DAILY_MARGINED: zero marked value and unrealized P&L, exposure-only futures_daily_margin_notional_reference, and P&L only through linked variation-margin or final-settlement events; prohibit gross notional as futures trade cash principal.
verification_evidence: independent quant-risk static audit: FUTURES_DAILY_MARGINED zero-marked-value checks passed

findings.evidence: Unsettled and failed settlement states needed signed payable/receivable accounting and an endpoint invalidation path; otherwise a failed delivery or transfer could be silently treated as completed.
findings.fix_required: Store gross, posted-or-paid, outstanding and signed residual values; only unposted payable/receivable residuals enter NAV; require FAILED to have zero posted/paid effect and make it invalidate the affected endpoint and block PASS.
verification_evidence: independent quant-risk static audit: signed unposted payable/receivable and FAILED-to-INVALID checks passed
